summary: Iteration 97 - P2P Arena backend verification: all 16 tests passed (100%). Covered betting config, pot min/max/stacking/cumulative-cap/unique-player-countdown/aggregation, coinflip challenge create/list/cancel boundary tests, and full coinflip e2e including rake calc and 25% prize-pool contribution.
critical_code_review_comments: pot_state is in-memory only (module global) - any backend restart wipes the active pot mid-round. For production reliability consider persisting pot in MongoDB or at least snapshotting to disk so a crash/redeploy doesn't vaporise user entries.

routers/pot.py draw_pot_winner uses secrets.randbelow(int(total * 1000000)) which will raise ValueError if total_amount_sol < 1e-6 (the int floors to 0). Current min-bet safeguards prevent this in practice, but add a guard for total > 0 before the randbelow call.

routers/pot.py /draw endpoint is unauthenticated and can be called by anyone as soon as 2 entries exist - bypasses the 60s countdown. Should be gated to DISTRIBUTION_WALLET/admin or triggered only by the scheduler after draw_at time passes.
betting.py create_challenge and pot/join use float comparisons; amounts like 0.004999... could slip through. Consider Decimal or an integer-lamports representation on the server side.
server.py file is 335 lines with multiple ad-hoc /admin endpoints (force-seed, rpc-diagnostic, force-sync-positions) inline - would be cleaner as an admin router module.

accept_challenge does not reserve/lock the challenge before executing the flip - two concurrent /accept calls could both proceed to update the same 'open' challenge. Use a findOneAndUpdate with status filter to atomically claim it.
test_credentials: Private Access Gate: bullpug2026 (not used - backend-only API tests). Test wallets are dummy base58-style strings.
seed_data_creation: Tests create p2p_challenges and prize_pool entries prefixed TEST_ where display_name applies; pot entries are in-memory and cleared by the class-level backend restart.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pot state is process-in-memory. TestPotSuite restarts backend in setup_class to guarantee a clean pot. Coinflip tests do not depend on pot state. send_sol_payout will typically report payout_sent=false in preview (no real keypair/funded escrow); assertions deliberately do not require payout_sent=true - they verify the outcome/rake/prize-pool math, which is the logic under test.
